title: Professional Certificate Course in Comparative Strategies For Marketing
description: Master the art of strategic marketing with Comparative Strategies For Marketing, unlocking the secrets to gaining a competitive edge in dynamic markets.
longDescription: Explore the depths of marketing strategy, from Porter’s generic strategies to innovative approaches like the General Electric Model. Dive into market dominance, defence strategies, and more, equipping yourself with the tools to outmanoeuvre competitors and drive business success.

modules.title: Comparative Strategies For Marketing
modules.summary: Gain expertise in comparative marketing strategies, exploring frameworks, models, and techniques to analyze markets, identify opportunities, and formulate winning strategies. From classic approaches to contemporary methodologies, equip yourself with the insights and skills needed to thrive in competitive business environments.

outcomes: Porter’s generic strategies and their applications in business.
The concept of Core Competencies and their role in shaping a company's competitive advantage.
Various Competitive Advantage Strategies used by organizations to gain an edge in the market.
The General Electric Model and its application in strategic planning, as well as the Shell Directional Policy Matrix and its significance in decision-making.
Market dominance strategies are employed by companies to establish a strong market presence.
Effectiveness of Market Defence Strategies used by businesses to protect their market position against competitors.
